description: Turn on another region for an Object Storage service (same price, the plan quota is shared). Returns the region's S3 endpoint. Use storage_plans for the region codes.

region.description: Region code from storage_plans or storage_overview, e.g. fra (Frankfurt), usa (Virginia), sgp (Singapore).

service_id.description: Object Storage service id, as returned by the matching list tool.

name: enable_storage_region
title: Turn on a storage region
